summary: Recurring Instagram account-recovery client who runs a peptide e-commerce brand under the handles @pepvidas and @pepvidashop (plus a third account, @24k.visuals). He came in August 2026 after @pepvidashop was taken down, handed over login credentials and 2FA codes, and got @pepvidas restored quickly; he then asked about clearing account restrictions and buying a safeguard/warranty package, requesting a discounted CAD price for the single restricted account. On 2026-09-09 all three of his accounts were banned simultaneously and he escalated urgently (asked for a phone call, said he'd 'return the favour'); as of 2026-09-13 @pepvidas is back, @pepvidashop is still pending appeal, and he wants a quote for @24k.visuals. He believes a competitor in the peptide space is paying to get him mass-reported/targeted.
key_facts: Runs peptide/supplement brand 'PepVida'; IG handles @pepvidas (Meta-verified business) and @pepvidashop
Third account @24k.visuals — quote requested 2026-09-13, not yet priced
Aug 2026: @pepvidas successfully recovered (near-instant after submission); @pepvidashop was the clapped account
Provided account credentials and relayed 2FA codes directly; password format used: Pepvida123_@shop / Pepvidashop123_@@@
Asked for a cheaper price in CAD (Canadian, area code 647/Toronto) on restriction removal for the single @pepvidashop account
Interested in ongoing safeguarding + warranty coverage — asked how long the warranty lasts and said he's down to buy if it protects the account
Was sent a PDF of account-safety best practices and says he's been following it; suspects the ban vector is his device
2026-09-09: all accounts banned at once, including other accounts on the same phone — suspects a competitor is paying for takedowns
Has deliberately not hit appeal on the banned accounts, waiting on instructions
Received a direct email from Meta on 2026-09-10
Open items as of 2026-09-13: @pepvidashop appeal status pending, login-error screenshot sent, @24k.visuals quote outstanding
